idea-plugin.name: Claude Brains
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Brains — a chat UI front-end for the Claude Code CLI, right inside your JetBrains IDE (WebStorm, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, etc). Wraps the claude CLI as a subprocess instead of relying on a bare terminal:
  • Streaming chat panel with markdown rendering
  • Multiple named, parallel sessions
  • Slash-command autocomplete
  • Model selector
  • Send selected code / whole file to Claude with one action
  • Floating prompt popup near the caret
Requires the Claude Code CLI to be installed separately and available on PATH (or configured with a full path in Settings). It runs the CLI as a subprocess and reuses its existing login, so no API key is needed.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • Streaming chat with reasoning, rendered in an embedded browser (markdown + syntax highlighting), with a Swing fallback
  • Tool activity with result status and collapsible output
  • File edits reviewable in the native diff viewer, with per-file and whole-turn revert
  • Persistent parallel sessions, usage analytics, permission modes, MCP server view, @-file references, image input, transcript export
